core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mounir corresponds to the Arabic form منير and is glossed in this record as “Luminous, illuminating.” The record associates the form with root ن و ر (n-w-r). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mounir corresponds to the Arabic form منير (Arabic root ن و ر (n-w-r); مُنِير (Munīr)). Its core sense is luminous, shining, radiant. Mounir is Arabic مُنِير (Munīr) 'luminous, illuminating', from the root ن و ر (n-w-r). The source gloss 'Guardian, Protector' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: منیر
persian.long_meaning: Mounir (منیر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن روشن، درخشان، تابان است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मुनीर
